features.name: What is a factor?
features.text: Any single point of differentiation the analysis focuses on: a brand, product, service, influencer or person of interest. An industry is not a factor; it contains several.

features.name: More than 10 factors
features.text: Custom pricing with our commercial team, since effort varies by factor.

features.name: Full personalization
features.text: Each report is built to your corporate identity, your language and the charts you need.

features.name: Flexible delivery
features.text: PDF, PPTX, executive summary, email, WhatsApp or API, with a cadence from daily to monthly.

features.name: Contract
features.text: Recurring monthly, with a 3-month minimum. Longer terms come with discounts. The first month builds the baseline.
